title: taxillus gibbosus

This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as lowering blood pressure and cholesterol levels, and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
